Vendored playable build (Pixi / Howler / GSAP). Audio is the ogg sprite,
inlined as a data URL so Howler never fetches. Spritesheet JSON + PNG
are served from a fetch hook (no network). The webpack bundle is patched
to expose DuckHuntStart instead of auto-booting, and its automatic
publicPath runtime falls back to "" instead of throwing (an inlined
srcdoc script has no src to derive a path from).
Looks like the NES zapper game — unofficial, same class as floppy-bird.
